TB.name: Cade Otton

TB.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
TB.detail: Godwin caught two of three targets for 16 yards and added a 12-yard rush during Sunday night's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

TB.name: Kenny Gainwell
TB.detail: Gainwell rushed five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

TB.name: Emeka Egbuka

TB.name: Tristan Wirfs

TEN.name: Fernando Carmona

TEN.name: Julius Chestnut
TEN.detail: Chestnut played all 25 of his snaps on special teams in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Jaguars.

TEN.name: Xavier Restrepo
TEN.detail: Restrepo, whom the Titans signed off their practice squad Tuesday, could be in store for more playing time out of the slot moving forward after Tennessee placed Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve, Mark Mihalko of USA Today reports.

TEN.name: Chimere Dike
TEN.detail: Dike caught two passes for 16 yards on three targets in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars. He added five rushing yards on one attempt.

TEN.name: Daniel Bellinger
TEN.detail: Bellinger caught two of three targets for six yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

TEN.name: Joey Slye
TEN.detail: Slye made all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also logged a tackle and forced a fumble.

TEN.name: Calvin Ridley
TEN.detail: Ridley played four offensive snaps and didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.

TEN.name: Gunnar Helm
TEN.detail: Helm caught all four of his targets for 23 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

TEN.name: Elic Ayomanor
TEN.detail: Ayomanor caught five of 10 targets for 79 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

TEN.name: Tony Pollard
TEN.detail: Pollard carried the ball nine times for 33 yards and caught eight of nine targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

TEN.name: Cam Ward
TEN.detail: Ward completed 28 of 39 passes for 231 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

WSH.name: Laremy Tunsil
WSH.detail: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Monday that Tunsil (triceps) is progressing as anticipated and is ready to begin the strength portion of his recovery program, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

WSH.name: Luke McCaffrey
WSH.detail: McCaffrey returned two punts for 13 yards and three kickoffs for 58 yards in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.

WSH.name: Jeremy Reaves
WSH.detail: Reaves recorded nine tackles (seven solo), one pass defense and one fumble recovery during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

WSH.name: Nick Cross
WSH.detail: Cross finished Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants with six tackles (one solo).

WSH.name: Frankie Luvu
WSH.detail: Luvu recorded six tackles (two solo) and a forced fumble during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

WSH.name: Sonny Styles
WSH.detail: Styles recorded 13 tackles (five solo) during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

WSH.name: Drew Stevens
WSH.detail: Stevens made his only field-goal attempt and was successful on all three of his extra-point tries in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.

WSH.name: Ben Sinnott
WSH.detail: Sinnott caught all four of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown Thursday in a 24-21 victory against the Giants.

WSH.name: Treylon Burks
WSH.detail: Burks caught two of three targets for 27 yards Thursday in a 24-21 win over the Giants.

WSH.name: Antonio Williams
WSH.detail: Williams secured both targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

WSH.name: Austin Ekeler
WSH.detail: Ekeler rushed nine times for 26 yards and brought in all four targets for 26 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

WSH.name: Rachaad White

WSH.name: Stefon Diggs
WSH.detail: Diggs secured six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

WSH.name: Jayden Daniels
WSH.detail: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

WSH.name: Chig Okonkwo
WSH.detail: Okonkwo (back) returned to Thursday's eventual 24-21 win at the Giants, finishing with four catches (on eight targets) for 24 yards.

WSH.name: Van Jefferson
WSH.detail: Jefferson caught five of seven targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.
